d: Italy's convictions in the 2018 Genoa bridge collapse case have renewed the debate over accountability after infrastructure disasters, marking a significant moment in public safety and governance. In this video from Firstpost Vantage, Hem Saroya explains how Italy pursued criminal accountability years after the tragedy, why similar disasters in India - including Morbi and Sairang - have seen investigations continue without final convictions, and what this reveals about oversight, negligence and enforcement. The video examines why compensation alone cannot prevent future disasters and why…
